description.value: Raisu is a Japanese restaurant on Vancouver's busy West 4th Avenue cycling corridor, specializing in Teishoku (Japanese set meals) and sake. It is part of a wider hospitality group with locations across Vancouver and Toronto. Both dine-in reservations and takeout/pickup are available, making it a practical stop for cyclists passing through Kitsilano.
